key_insight: The paper proves the Fong-Tsui conjecture in full generality: for a bounded operator T on any complex Hilbert space, the inequality |T| ≤ |Re T| forces T to be self-adjoint.
engineering_relevance: This gives a dimension-free operator-theoretic criterion and a quantitative stability bound that can inform robust analysis of linear systems, numerical operator approximations, and verification workflows.
method: Use a positive inverse of a Sylvester map to control operator relations.
Apply a spectral cutoff based on the defect norm |Re T| - |T|.
Combine a local vanishing lemma with a global norm contradiction to deduce self-adjointness.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a general proof on arbitrary complex Hilbert spaces plus a quantitative estimate |Im T| ≤ 6|T|^{7/8}ε^{1/8} under a perturbed inequality.
watch_item: The stability exponent is explicitly stated as non-optimal, so the bound should be treated as qualitative rather than sharp for implementation.
paper_title: A General Proof of the Fong-Tsui Conjecture
